commit_message: Add ADR0126 Timeline foundation on current main
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0126 Timeline and Sequencer
pr_body:
## Summary

Replays the already-reviewed ADR0126 Timeline foundation onto the current-main baseline after parallel ADR merges. The request remains a Draft PR and does not merge main.

This foundation provides the neutral Timeline clock/schedule/player, stable IDs and persistence, deterministic compile/evaluation, transactional authoring service, capability registry and CLI/MCP surfaces, and shared camera selection override groundwork. Subsequent requests on this same task branch add the schema correction, production runtime composition, Project Rust integration, and dedicated Sequencer Editor/visual validation required for first-release completion.
